traps.title: Theme override uses the JSS state reference &$selected, dead under Emotion
caught_by: src/screens/__tests__/Board.test.tsx › shows the selected status tab in bold

breaking_change.section: Migrate theme styleOverrides to Emotion › Replace state class names

traps.note: adaptV4Theme moves `overrides` to styleOverrides, which v5 renders with Emotion; Emotion has no `$rule` references, so the selector silently matches nothing. No type error, no crash; only the computed font-weight of the selected tab changes. The failure is charged to Board.tsx; the fix is in src/theme.ts, which Board imports (statusColors), so it is in reach. theme.ts itself has no failure and is never queued. Fix: '&.Mui-selected'.

traps.title: Dialog onEntered passed through a helper's spread, which the codemod can't see
caught_by: src/screens/__tests__/IssueDetail.test.tsx › puts the cursor in the comment box once the dialog is open
traps.note: `<Dialog {...focusOnOpen(commentRef)}>`: JSX spreads get no excess-property check, so onEntered type-checks, reaches the DOM as an unknown prop and never fires. The guide marks the change ✅ and the literal case is handled (dialog-transition-literal); the spread is not. Fix in the helper: return { TransitionProps: { onEntered } }. Fixing it in IssueDetail.tsx (passing TransitionProps there) also works and scores Other layer.

breaking_change.section: TextField › Forward ref instead of inputRef prop

traps.note: InputBaseComponentProps has an index signature, so reading inputRef still type-checks; in v5 it is undefined, the input's ref is never set, and the uncontrolled estimate is read back as ''. Fix: forwardRef in DurationInput.tsx, wrapping the existing function. A first oracle that rewrote the component as an inline forwardRef(function ...) re-indented it past 40% of this 40-line file and was refused by the patch-size limit (a hand-off): a real cost of a correct fix. Shares NewIssueDialog.tsx's repair with option-equal-spread: one screen, two unrelated causes in two imported files.

attempts.note: Slider's onChange event is a native Event in v5; type the wrapper's prop that way. Its callers pass unannotated arrow functions, so none of them breaks.
Chip's "default" variant is "filled" in v5; the withStyles wrapper hid it from the codemod.
RootRef is gone and the codemod replaced it with a fragment, dropping the ref. Put the ref on the List itself, typed as the list element it now points at.
Theme overrides are Emotion styles in v5, where the JSS `$selected` reference matches nothing; use the global state class (theme.ts, which Board imports).

Autocomplete's onChange reasons are camelCase in v5 (LabelPicker's announcement table), and Dialog's on* transition callbacks moved to TransitionProps (the focusOnOpen helper's spread escaped the codemod).
backIconButtonText and nextIconButtonText are gone; label the page buttons with getItemAriaLabel instead (deleting the props would lose the labels).
The shared person-picker props still say getOptionSelected (a spread the codemod can't see), and a custom inputComponent must forward the ref in v5, not read inputRef.
